verdict.rationale: The evidence documents Custom Agent Skills (a code-based developer guide), no-code Agent Flows, and MCP compatibility. These are ways to build or connect capabilities, not a browsable registry with one-command or one-click install. No skills or plugins hub, marketplace, or install flow appears anywhere in the pack, so the applicable axis has no supporting evidence.

support.subject: As a power user, I can browse a real skills/plugins registry and install a capability with one command or click
